name: ESP_BIST
help:
Enable the built-in self-test (BIST) feature for the system.
This feature allows for self-diagnosis and verification of system
components during startup or at runtime.

depends on ESP_BIST

name: ESP_BIST_CPU_REG_TEST
help: Enable tests for CPU registers.

name: ESP_BIST_CPU_CSR_REG_TEST
help: Enable tests for CPU Control and Status Registers (CSRs).

name: ESP_BIST_MEMORY_RAM_TEST
help:
Enable tests for the RAM memory integrity (March A, March X, and
Abraham).

name: ESP_BIST_RAM_PARTITION_SIZE
help:
Size of each RAM test partition in 32-bit words. March A/X test one
partition at a time; Abraham tests pairs. Larger values reduce the
number of Abraham pairs C(N,2) and thus the execution time of
bist_ram_test_abraham_full(), at the cost of a larger safe-RAM
backup buffer (2 x partition_size x 4 bytes).

Common values:
256  = 1 KiB partitions, 2 KiB backup buffer (LP core default)
512  = 2 KiB partitions, 4 KiB backup buffer (standalone default)
1024 = 4 KiB partitions, 8 KiB backup buffer

name: ESP_BIST_STACK_TEST
help: Enable tests for the stack integrity.

name: ESP_BIST_PROGRAM_COUNTER_TEST
help: Enable tests for the program counter.

name: ESP_BIST_MEMORY_FLASH_TEST
help: Enable tests for the Flash memory integrity.

name: ESP_BIST_CLOCK_TEST
help: Enable tests for the main crystal clock.

name: ESP_BIST_GPIO_TEST
help: Enable tests for the GPIO pins.

name: ESP_BIST_ADC_TEST
help: Enable tests for the ADC pins.

name: ESP_BIST_WATCHDOG_TEST
help: Enable tests for the HP main watchdog timer (MWDT).

name: ESP_BIST_WDT_TIMEOUT_US
help:
Maximum time between watchdog feeds in microseconds.

On the LP core (ESP-IDF ULP integration), this configures the LP WDT
timeout via lp_wdt_init(). On HP core / standalone builds, this configures
the main watchdog timer (MWDT).

name: BIST_FLASH_TEST_CHUNK_SIZE
help: Specify the chunk size in bytes for flash memory testing.

name: ESP_BIST_CLOCK_PERCENT_FREQUENCY_DRIFT
help: Specify the acceptable percentage of frequency drift for the clock test.

name: ESP_BIST_ADC_PERCENT_DEVIATION
help:
Specify the acceptable percentage deviation of ADC readings from
the expected low or high reference values for the ADC plausibility tests.

name: ESP_BIST_FLASH_SIZE
help: Specify the size of the flash memory in bytes.

name: ESP_BIST_HEAP_SIZE
help:
Specify the size of the heap in bytes. This is used for dynamic memory allocation
during BIST operations. A value of 0 means no heap is allocated.

name: ESP_BIST_STACK_PROTECTION_BLOCK_SIZE
help:
Specify the size of the stack protection block in bytes. This is used to protect
the stack from overflow and underflow conditions. A value of 0 means no protection
block is allocated.

name: ESP_BIST_WDT_WINDOWED_UNDERFLOW_TIMEOUT_US
help:
Specify the timeout for the windowed underflow condition in microseconds.
This is used to ensure that the watchdog timer does not trigger an underflow
condition during application time-slot.

name: ESP_BIST_METRICS
help:
Enable the collection of performance metrics during BIST operations, such as
execution time, CPU cycles, and instruction counts.
